Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed collectible card illustration for FAULTLINE, a ruined orbital relay network tactics game.
Style/medium: premium detailed painterly oil concept art, tangible intricate engineering craftsmanship. Card: Honeypot. Gameplay meaning (context only, do not write it in the image): A decoy attracts hostile jams and cuts and damages the attacker.
Subject and action: On a dark engineering bench a small alluring honey-amber glass decoy router in an open brass lure cage is cabled to the network. The unmistakable decoy-and-trap device dominates; subtle real ivory router protected in the background. Warm amber focal glow. Avoid a literal honey jar or bees.
